sloka: तेन चाहमनुज्ञातो मैनाकेन महात्मना ।स चाप्यन्तर्हितः शैलो मानुषेण वपुष्मता ।शरीरेण महाशैलः शैलेन च महोदधौ ।। ५.५८.१९ ।।।।
transliteration: tena cāhamanujñāto mainākena mahātmanā ।sa cāpyantarhitaḥ śailo mānuṣeṇa vapuṣmatā ।śarīreṇa mahāśailaḥ śailena ca mahodadhau ।। 5.58.19 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then the huge mountain in human form concealed as huge mountains remain hidden in the ocean.
